claims.text: The St. Regis Aspen Resort is located at the base of Aspen Mountain, close to both the town and the mountain.

findings.quote: The St. Regis Aspen Resort is located at the base of Aspen Mountain and puts you in great proximity to the town and the mountain.

claims.text: The hotel is a three-minute walk from the base of Aspen Mountain, or five minutes in ski boots.

findings.quote: Just a three-minute walk from the base of Aspen Mountain (or five minutes, if ski boots are on)

claims.text: The resort has a heated outdoor pool and hot tubs that overlook Aspen Mountain.

findings.quote: Enjoy our heated outdoor pool and hot tubs that overlook stunning Aspen Mountain.

claims.text: The spa includes the Confluence, reminiscent of the hot springs in Colorado.

findings.quote: It offers 15,000 sq. ft. of space, luxurious treatments, a world-class fitness center, and the Confluence, reminiscent of the hot springs in Colorado.

claims.text: Velvet Buck uses local, seasonal ingredients in a fusion of multiple cuisines and serves breakfast daily.

findings.quote: Velvet Buck utilizes local, seasonal ingredients to create an exquisite fusion of multiple cuisines and offers breakfast daily.

claims.text: Apres Tea in Mountain Social Bar & Lounge is inspired by Caroline Astor, with an alpine twist.

findings.quote: in Mountain Social Bar & Lounge to celebrate a timeless experience inspired by Caroline Astor with an alpine twist

claims.text: Rooms, suites and residences have 400-thread-count Frette linens and marble bathrooms.

findings.quote: Our hotel rooms, suites, and residences feature sumptuous 400-thread-count Frette linens, spacious marble bathrooms

claims.text: Two-bedroom suites have living space, fireplaces and kitchenettes.

findings.quote: Reserve a two-bedroom hotel suite in Aspen with ample living space, cozy fireplaces and kitchenettes

claims.text: St. Regis Butler Service is available 24 hours a day.

findings.quote: St. Regis Butler Service is ready to assist you 24 hours a day.

claims.text: Ski valets help with ski and snowboard equipment and offer local knowledge of terrain and conditions.

findings.quote: Ski Valet make the transition from guest room to ski slope seamless. They assist with ski and snowboard equipment as well as offer local knowledge of terrain and conditions.

claims.text: The hotel partners with the Aspen Outfitting Company for guided activities including fly fishing and clay target shooting.

findings.quote: The St. Regis Aspen partners with the Aspen Outfitting Company to provide travelers and residents with an unparalleled selection of guided activities, ranging from: Fly fishing, clay target shooting

claims.text: Four ski mountains are within reach: Snowmass, Aspen, Aspen Highlands and Buttermilk.

findings.quote: With four world-class mountains within reach (Snowmass, Aspen, Aspen Highlands and Buttermilk Mountain)

claims.text: The resort is a host hotel for the FOOD and WINE Classic in Aspen.

findings.quote: A host hotel for the FOOD and WINE Classic in Aspen

claims.text: Mountain Social Bar & Lounge hosts a daily champagne sabering.

findings.quote: Experience our daily champagne sabering or sip on a signature cocktail in our Aspen Mountain bar.

claims.text: The hotel's local take on the St. Regis Bloody Mary is the Downhill Snapper, made with dill, basil and citrus.

findings.quote: with each hotel crafting its own local interpretation of the libation
Discover the Downhill Snapper: a garden-to-glass homage to Colorado
highlighted with dill, basil, and citrus at The St. Regis Aspen Resort

claims.text: The Silver Circle Ice Rink is adjacent to the hotel.

findings.quote: The Silver Circle Ice Rink is adjacent to the hotel.

claims.text: For suite guests, butlers handle unpacking and packing, morning beverage service, garment pressing and shoeshine.

findings.quote: For our Suite guests, unpacking and packing, morning beverage service, garment pressing, and shoeshine are a few of the everyday services provided by the gracious Butlers

claims.text: Aspen's ski and snowboard season runs from about Thanksgiving weekend to the first few weeks of April.

findings.quote: Indulge in Aspen skiing or snowboarding from approximately Thanksgiving weekend to the first few weeks in April.

claims.text: Aspen-Pitkin County Airport is about 3 miles from the hotel, and the hotel has an airport shuttle to it.

findings.quote: The closest airport near The St. Regis Aspen Resort is Aspen-Pitkin County Airport (ASE). ASE is located approximately 3.0 Miles from the hotel.
Yes, The St. Regis Aspen Resort has an airport shuttle to Aspen-Pitkin County Airport (ASE).
